_comment: WO-598 vendor/shops REGISTRY - the per-vendor STOCK QUERY (the honest shelf). Loaded by DeNelle.Village.VendorRegistry via DeNelle.Core.CanonicalJson (Resources first, StreamingAssets fallback). Each vendor's shelf is a QUERY over the item catalogs (weapons/armor/accessories/consumables/materials), never a hardcoded list: 'categories' names which catalog bands the vendor stocks, 'classFilter':'roster' drops items no CURRENTLY-PLAYABLE class can use (Knight-only V1 via ff.knightonly -> no Mage wands at the Forge), 'maxReqLevel' (0 = uncapped) tier-gates the shelf, and 'emptyLine' is the AUTHORED never-raw empty-state line. VendorStockContract.AllowedFor consults this registry FIRST (categories -> GearKind flags) so the legacy shop, the MVVM PartyShop, ShopCatalog and the AutoPilot oracle all read ONE truth.

_schemaNotes.id: vendor/structure id (buildings.json isShoppable id, the vendorContext DialogueService.PlayStructure routes). Matched exact first, then substring (so 'blacksmith_forge' finds 'forge').
_schemaNotes.layout: gear | goods | jeweler - which shelf PRESENTATION the shop binds (gear = weapons/armor + party fit; goods = flat consumables/materials list, no equip context; jeweler = rings/amulets/gems).
_schemaNotes.categories: weapon | armor | consumable | material | ring | amulet | accessory | gem | craftable - the catalog bands this vendor's query pulls.
_schemaNotes.classFilter: roster (default: only items obtainable by the current playable roster - Knight-only under ff.knightonly) | none.
_schemaNotes.maxReqLevel: 0 = uncapped; N = don't stock items requiring level > N (tier gate). Level-locked rows still SHOW as 'Requires Lv N'.
_schemaNotes.emptyLine: authored 'come back later' line shown when the query resolves 0 items - a vendor never renders a raw empty grid.

vendors.emptyLine: The stalls are bare today - the caravan hasn't come in yet. Check back after the next haul.
The coals are hot but the racks are bare - come back once I've hammered out the next batch.
Nothing on the racks would fit you today - come back after the next fitting.
Sable's cases are empty - the next cutting isn't finished. Come back in a while.
